_comment: Single source of truth for GitHub identity per repo. Read by the gh-identity-guard and gh-commit-author-guard PreToolUse hooks. ssh_host is the host-alias (from ~/.ssh/config) that decides push identity for SSH remotes; gh_account decides for HTTPS / gh-CLI ops. Tag each repo once: `git config claude.identity <id>`. Copy to ~/.claude/github-identity-map.json and edit.

PublicPseudonym.note: Pseudonym for public repos — must stay unlinked from your real name. WHY: the guard exists so a public push can never carry your personal identity by accident.

local-only.note: Repos that must never be pushed anywhere.
